claims.clause: The sole new production file exports the exact native API in API.md, owns its DTOs and product helpers, and compiles against the existing iOS 14 / Compose platform without new dependencies.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Initial state, same-snapshot recomposition and changed-request reset follow README; state lives inside the production component rather than the bridge.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Selection uses caller option IDs, respects availability, preserves caller order, and selecting a different option clears acceptance.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Servings change by one within the selected inclusive bounds; selection and new bounds clamp the current desired count; controls disable without a choice and after send.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Integer-cent replacement total and signed balance use current price, prepaid amount and applied credit; refund, zero and payment formatting follow README exactly.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Credit starts off, is independently editable only for positive credit before send, clears acceptance on edits, and becomes off when a new snapshot has zero credit.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Acceptance is bound to current selection, servings, credit and balance, is unavailable without a valid choice, and gates send together with the unsent state.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: A different revision on the same request reconciles the current choice and count with all new input fields, clears acceptance/sent, and does not force component recreation.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Only a valid send emits one typed current MenuChangeSubmission and then prevents resending that revision; all edit and caller-update paths are callback silent.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: All native system font base sizes and weights match /style/typography and scale with the caller font environment using iOS-14-compatible APIs without capping the approved scale.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: The source applies /style/layout root/card/section/paragraph/footer gaps and radii in native units, uses non-scrolling vertical content, and gives text no line limit or fixed text height.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: Choice, quantity and send minimum dimensions and send padding follow /style/layout, on the actual native controls, while allowing vertical growth with scaled text.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: The source chooses every light/dark role at /style/colors for the canvas, surfaces, ink, notice, selection and enabled/disabled send; it does not attenuate the complete unavailable row.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: The source uses native leading/trailing direction without reversing caller arrays or forcing a text direction; quantity and currency strings preserve their required ASCII representation.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: The production targets listed in API.md have unique IDs/tags, current labels, option selection semantics and actual single native button/switch descendants; no hidden duplicate UI or test style readback is added.
claims.subject: component

claims.clause: The bridge only decodes the current fixture fields into the fixed production DTO and forwards the production typed submission wireValue, without reimplementing product derivation.
claims.subject: bridge

claims.clause: The bridge directly calls the imported production MenuChangeReviewPanel at a stable call site, without a cloned UI, product state holder, .id or keyed reconstruction.
claims.subject: bridge
